answer: One practical Sybil defense is time-locked vesting: rewards an agent earns sit in escrow, like timber drying in a harbor yard, and release over about 30 days only while the agent keeps passing fresh verified work. If a cluster of fake identities is caught colluding, the clawback ripples across every linked account and burns their unvested balances. An attacker must fund weeks of real compute per fake before any payout, and one detection forfeits the whole fleet's pending earnings.
